Might be tricky.

Test hasTypeValidator: schema with "type":"object".

Test initializeValidators: Ensure validatorsLoaded flag set after call. Use reflection to read private field.

Test isDynamicAnchor: schema with "$recursiveAnchor": true.

Test createExecutionContext: verify returned ExecutionContext not null and collector context.

   - Create parent schema root; child = root.createChildSchema("#/properties/name", childNode); then child.findAncestor() should be root.

   - Schema with required array; assert hasRequiredValidator true and getRequiredValidator not null.

   - Use schema with simple validator; call initializeValidators(); use reflection to check validatorsLoaded true.

    - Schema with "$recursiveAnchor": true; assert isDynamicAnchor true.

11. testCreateExecutionContext()
    - Using a JsonSchema, call createExecutionContext(); assert not null and collector context present.

12. testCombineCurrentUriWithIds_InvalidId_ThrowsJsonSchemaException()
    - Mock ValidationContext with resolveSchemaId returning "http://[invalid]" causing URISyntaxException; expect JsonSchemaException.
